errors.text_span: 图表中的水平轴显示了Top1000的数字，从Top100到Top4000，以递减的顺序排列。垂直轴表示“在”介动搭配出现的次数
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the horizontal and vertical axes. The horizontal axis shows numerical values, while the vertical axis shows categories (Top100 to Top1000).
The chart categories range from Top100 to Top1000. There is no "Top4000" category.
The horizontal axis range is from 0 to 400, not 0 to 350.
The chart represents two different metrics, '介动紧密度' (orange bars) and '频次' (blue bars). There is no single unit of '个动词密度' for the axis.
The chart contains 20 bars in total (10 categories, each with 2 bars for the two different metrics), not four.
The description only mentions the orange ('橘红色') bars and completely omits the blue bars, which represent the '频次' metric and constitute the majority of the visual data.

errors.text_span: 数值分别是Top700为大约70个动词密度，Top800为大约80个动词密度，Top900为大约90个动词密度
errors.evidence: These values are incorrect. The chart shows the orange bars for Top700, Top800, and Top900 are all below 30. The blue bars for these categories are approximately 280, 310, and 350, respectively. The reported values do not match either series.

errors.text_span: 以及Top1000为大约350个动词密度
errors.evidence: The description reads the blue bar for Top1000 (approx. 380, so 350 is a rough estimate) but attributes it to the same series as the previous (incorrectly read) values, without acknowledging the existence of two different data series (orange and blue).

errors.text_span: 所有柱状图都位于图表中的同一水平位置。
errors.evidence: This is false. Each bar or group of bars is at a different vertical position corresponding to its category on the y-axis.
